MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o)-[r:Owns]->(:Team)
WITH o, r,
  CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '^([0-9]{4})', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/([0-9]{1,2})/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
  CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/([0-9]{1,2})', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH o, r,
  CASE
    WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14)
      THEN 2026 - birth_year - 1
    ELSE 2026 - birth_year
  END AS age
WHERE age <= 76 OR o.name = 'Joseph Chung-Hsin Tsai' OR CAST(r.since_year AS INT64) > 2013 OR o.nationality = 'American'
RETURN r.since_year AS col1, age AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager

MATCH (o:Owner)-[r:Owns]->(:Team), (o)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH o, r,
  CASE WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}$') THEN CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '^([0-9]{4})/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE NULL END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}$') THEN CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/([0-9]{1,2})/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE NULL END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}$') THEN CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/([0-9]{1,2})$', 1) AS INT64) ELSE NULL END AS birth_day,
  CASE WHEN regexp_matches(r.since_year, '^[0-9]{4}$') THEN CAST(r.since_year AS INT64) ELSE NULL END AS ownership_year
WITH o, r, ownership_year,
  CASE
    WHEN birth_year IS NULL OR birth_month IS NULL OR birth_day IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 2026 - birth_year - 1
    ELSE 2026 - birth_year
  END AS age
WHERE age <= 76 OR o.name = 'Joseph Chung-Hsin Tsai' OR ownership_year > 2013 OR o.nationality = 'American'
RETURN r.since_year AS col1, age AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
